measurement_definitions.prefill_compute_tokens_per_s: native computed KV tokens divided by native request prefill seconds
measurement_definitions.weighted_decode_tokens_per_s: generated tokens after the first token of each request divided by summed native request decode seconds
measurement_definitions.aggregate_prefill_wave_tokens_per_s: all prompt tokens in the wave divided by time from simultaneous release until the last request emits its first token
measurement_definitions.aggregate_decode_wave_tokens_per_s: all post-first output tokens in the wave divided by time from the earliest first token until the final request completes
measurement_definitions.effective_decode_concurrency: summed native per-request decode seconds divided by aggregate decode-window seconds; aggregate decode equals weighted per-request decode multiplied by this occupancy
measurement_definitions.fully_overlapped_aggregate_decode_tokens: native generation-token counter delta divided by sampled wall time after every request emitted its first token and before any request completed
measurement_definitions.tpot_s: client time after first generated event divided by completion tokens minus one
measurement_definitions.batch_wall_s: elapsed time from simultaneous release until every request in the wave completed
measurement_definitions.e2e_policy: reported in seconds; legacy aggregate output tokens per wall second is retained only in per-case raw data
